name: Acid
description: Chemical species that donates protons (H+) or accepts electron pairs.

name: Base
description: Chemical species that accepts protons or donates electron pairs (alkalis when dissolved in water).

name: Salt
description: Ionic compound formed from the neutralization reaction of an acid and a base.

name: Metal Elemental/Substance
description: Metallic chemical element or elemental metal substance.

name: Nonmetal Elemental/Substance
description: Nonmetallic element or simple nonmetallic substance.

name: Oxide
description: Chemical compound that contains at least one oxygen atom and another element in its chemical formula.

name: pH / Chemical Indicator
description: Substance that changes color in response to a chemical change (such as pH change).

name: Inorganic Chemical
description: Chemical compound that lacks carbon-hydrogen bonds.

name: Gas
description: Substance existing in a gaseous physical state under standard ambient temperature and pressure.

name: Liquid
description: Substance existing in a liquid physical state under standard ambient conditions.

name: Solid
description: Substance existing in a solid physical state under standard ambient conditions.

name: Solution
description: Homogeneous mixture composed of two or more substances (usually aqueous).

name: Solvent
description: Substance that dissolves a solute, resulting in a solution.
